cosh.title: Trigonometric Functions
cosh.description: The cosh function returns the hyperbolic cosine of its argument.

cot.name: cot
cot.title: Trigonometric Functions
cot.description: The cot function returns the cotangent of its argument.

coth.name: coth
coth.title: Trigonometric Functions
coth.description: The coth function returns the hyperbolic cotangent of its argument.

csc.name: csc
csc.title: Trigonometric Functions
csc.description: The csc function returns the cosecant of its argument.

csch.name: csch
csch.title: Trigonometric Functions
csch.description: The csch function returns the hyperbolic cosecant of its argument.

sec.name: sec
sec.title: Trigonometric Functions
sec.description: The sec function returns the secant of its argument.

sech.name: sech
sech.title: Trigonometric Functions
sech.description: The sech function returns the hyperbolic secant of its argument.

sin.name: sin
sin.title: Trigonometric Functions
sin.description: The sin function returns the sine of its argument.

sinh.name: sinh
sinh.title: Trigonometric Functions
sinh.description: The sinh function returns the hyperbolic sine of its argument.

tan.name: tan
tan.title: Trigonometric Functions
tan.description: The tan function returns the tangent of its argument.

tanh.name: tanh
tanh.title: Trigonometric Functions
tanh.description: The tanh function returns the hyperbolic tangent of its argument.

atan2.name: atan2
atan2.title: Two Argument Arctangent
atan2.description: The atan2 function returns the arctangent of the value y/x where the arguments represent the point (x,y) in a Cartesian coordinate system.

deg-grad.name: deg-grad
deg-grad.title: Convert From Degrees to Grads
deg-grad.description: The deg-grad function converts its only argument (which should be a numeric expression) from units of degrees to units of grads (360 degrees = 400 grads).

deg-rad.name: deg-rad
deg-rad.title: Convert From Degrees to Radians
deg-rad.description: The deg-rad function converts its only argument (which should be a numeric expression) from units of degrees to units of radians (360 degrees = 2π radians).

grad-deg.name: grad-deg
grad-deg.title: Convert From Grads to Degrees
grad-deg.description: The grad-deg function converts its only argument (which should be a numeric expression) from units of grads to units of degrees (360 degrees = 400 grads).

rad-deg.name: rad-deg
rad-deg.title: Convert From Radians to Degrees
rad-deg.description: The rad-deg function converts its only argument (which should be a numeric expression) from units of radians to units of degrees (360 degrees = 2π radians).

pi.name: pi
pi.title: Return the Value of π
pi.description: The pi function returns the value of π (3.141592653589793...) as a float.

sqrt.name: sqrt
sqrt.title: Square Root
sqrt.description: The sqrt function returns the square root of its only argument (which should be a numeric expression) as a float.

**.title: Power
**.description: The ** function raises its first argument to the power of its second argument and returns this value as a float.

exp.name: exp
exp.title: Exponential
exp.description: The exp function raises the value e (the base of the natural system of logarithms, having a value of approximately 2.718...) to the power specified by its only argument and returns this value as a float.

log.name: log
log.title: Logarithm
log.description: Given n (the only argument) and the value e is the base of the natural system of logarithms, the log function returns the float value x such that the following equation is satisfied: x n = e

log10.name: log10
log10.title: Logarithm Base 10
log10.description: Given n (the only argument), the log10 function returns the float value x such that the following equation is satisfied: x n = 10

round.name: round
round.title: Round
round.description: The round function rounds its only argument (which should be a numeric expression) toward the closest integer.

mod.name: mod
mod.title: Modulus
mod.description: The mod function returns the remainder of the result of dividing its first argument by its second argument (assuming that the result of division must be an integer).

if.name: if
if.title: If...then...else Function
if.description: The if function allows conditional execution of a set of actions.

while.name: while
while.title: While
while.description: The while function allows simple looping based on a condition.

loop-for-count.name: loop-for-count
loop-for-count.title: Loop-for-count
loop-for-count.description: The loop-for-count function allows iterative looping.

progn.name: progn
progn.title: Progn
progn.description: The progn function evaluates all of its arguments and returns the value of the last argument.

progn$.name: progn$
progn$.title: Progn$
progn$.description: The progn$ function performs a set of actions for each field of a multifield value.

break.name: break
break.title: Break
break.description: The break function immediately terminates the currently iterating while loop, loop-for-count execution, progn execution, progn$ execution, foreach execution, or fact/instance set query function.

switch.name: switch
switch.title: Switch
switch.description: The switch function selects a particular group of actions (among several groups of actions) to perform based on a specified value.

foreach.name: foreach
foreach.title: Foreach
foreach.description: The foreach function performs a set of actions for each field of a multifield value.

try.name: try
try.title: Try
try.description: The try function performs a set of actions, and if an error occurs, allows another set of actions to be performed.

gensym.name: gensym
gensym.title: Gensym
gensym.description: The gensym function returns a sequenced generated symbol that can be stored as a single field.

gensym*.name: gensym*
gensym*.title: Gensym*
gensym*.description: The gensym* function is similar to the gensym function, however, it will produce a unique symbol that does not currently exist within the CLIPS environment.

setgen.name: setgen
setgen.title: Setgen
setgen.description: The setgen function assigns the starting integer used by the gensym and gensym* functions.

random.name: random
random.title: Random
random.description: The random function returns a random integer value.

seed.name: seed
seed.title: Seed
seed.description: The seed function seeds the random number generator.

time.name: time
time.title: Time
time.description: The time function returns a floating-point value representing the elapsed seconds since the system reference time.

get-function-restrictions.name: get-function-restrictions
get-function-restrictions.title: Determining the Restrictions for a Function
get-function-restrictions.description: The get-function-restrictions function can be used to gain access to the restriction string associated with a system or user defined function created using the AddUDF API. The restriction string contains information on the number and types of arguments that a function expects.

sort.name: sort
sort.title: Sorting a List of Values
sort.description: The sort function allows a list of values to be sorted.

funcall.name: funcall
funcall.title: Calling a Function
funcall.description: The funcall function constructs a function call from its arguments and then evaluates the function call.

timer.name: timer
timer.title: Timing Functions and Commands
timer.description: The timer function returns the number of seconds elapsed evaluating a series of expressions.

operating-system.name: operating-system
operating-system.title: Determining the Operating System
operating-system.description: The operating-system function returns a symbol indicating the opertating system on which CLIPS is running.

local-time.name: local-time
local-time.title: Local Time
local-time.description: The local-time function returns a multifield value containing fields indicating the local time.

gm-time.name: gm-time
gm-time.title: Greenwich Mean Time
gm-time.description: The gm-time function returns returns a multifield value containing fields indicating Greenwich mean time.

get-error.name: get-error
get-error.title: Getting the Error State
get-error.description: The get-error function returns the current value of the error state (or status value).

clear-error.name: clear-error
clear-error.title: Clearing the Error State
clear-error.description: The clear-error function resets the error state (or status value) to the the symbol FALSE and returns the prior value of the error state.

set-error.name: set-error
set-error.title: Setting the Error State
set-error.description: The set-error function sets the error state (or status value).

void.name: void
void.title: Void Value
void.description: The void function returns the void value.

deftemplate-module.name: deftemplate-module
deftemplate-module.title: Determining the Module in which a Deftemplate is Defined
deftemplate-module.description: The deftemplate-module function returns the module in which the specified deftemplate name is defined.

deftemplate-slot-allowed-values.name: deftemplate-slot-allowed-values
deftemplate-slot-allowed-values.title: Getting the Allowed Values for a Deftemplate Slot
deftemplate-slot-allowed-values.description: The deftemplate-slot-allowed-values function groups the allowed values for a slot (specified in any of allowed-… attributes for the slots) into a multifield variable.

deftemplate-slot-cardinality.name: deftemplate-slot-cardinality
deftemplate-slot-cardinality.title: Getting the Cardinality for a Deftemplate Slot
deftemplate-slot-cardinality.description: The deftemplate-slot-cardinality function groups the minimum and maximum cardinality allowed for a multifield slot into a multifield variable.

deftemplate-slot-defaultp.name: deftemplate-slot-defaultp
deftemplate-slot-defaultp.title: Testing whether a Deftemplate Slot has a Default
deftemplate-slot-defaultp.description: The deftemplate-slot-defaultp function returns the symbol static if the specified slot in the specified deftemplate has a static default (whether explicitly or implicitly defined), the symbol dynamic if the slot has a dynamic default, or the symbol FALSE if the slot does not have a default.

deftemplate-slot-default-value.name: deftemplate-slot-default-value
deftemplate-slot-default-value.title: Getting the Default Value for a Deftemplate Slot
deftemplate-slot-default-value.description: The deftemplate-slot-default-value function returns the default value associated with a deftemplate slot.

deftemplate-slot-existp.name: deftemplate-slot-existp
deftemplate-slot-existp.title: Deftemplate Slot Existence
deftemplate-slot-existp.description: The deftemplate-slot-existp function returns the symbol TRUE if the specified slot is present in the specified deftemplate; otherwise, it returns the symbol FALSE.

deftemplate-slot-multip.name: deftemplate-slot-multip
deftemplate-slot-multip.title: Testing whether a Deftemplate Slot is a Multifield Slot
deftemplate-slot-multip.description: The deftemplate-slot-multip function returns the symbol TRUE if the specified slot in the specified deftemplate is a multifield slot; otherwise, it returns the symbol FALSE. An error is generated if the specified deftemplate or slot does not exist.

deftemplate-slot-names.name: deftemplate-slot-names
deftemplate-slot-names.title: Determining the Slot Names Associated with a Deftemplate
deftemplate-slot-names.description: The deftemplate-slot-names function returns the slot names associated with the deftemplate in a multifield value.

deftemplate-slot-range.name: deftemplate-slot-range
deftemplate-slot-range.title: Getting the Numeric Range for a Deftemplate Slot
deftemplate-slot-range.description: The deftemplate-slot-range function groups the minimum and maximum numeric ranges allowed for a slot into a multifield variable.

deftemplate-slot-singlep.name: deftemplate-slot-singlep
deftemplate-slot-singlep.title: Testing whether a Deftemplate Slot is a Single-Field Slot
deftemplate-slot-singlep.description: The deftemplate-slot-singlep function returns the symbol TRUE if the specified slot in the specified deftemplate is a single-field slot; otherwise, it returns the symbol FALSE. An error is generated if the specified deftemplate or slot does not exist.

deftemplate-slot-types.name: deftemplate-slot-types
deftemplate-slot-types.title: Getting the Primitive Types for a Deftemplate Slot
deftemplate-slot-types.description: The deftemplate-slot-types function groups the names of the primitive types allowed for a deftemplate slot into a multifield variable.

get-deftemplate-list.name: get-deftemplate-list
get-deftemplate-list.title: Getting the List of Deftemplates
get-deftemplate-list.description: The get-deftemplate-list function returns a multifield value containing the names of all deftemplate constructs facts visible to the module specified by <module-name> or to the current module if none is specified.

assert.name: assert
assert.title: Creating New Facts
assert.description: The assert function creates new facts and adds them to the fact-list.

retract.name: retract
retract.title: Removing Facts from the Fact-list
retract.description: The retract function removes facts from the fact-list.

modify.name: modify
modify.title: Modifying Template Facts
modify.description: The modify function modifies the slot values of an existing template fact.

duplicate.name: duplicate
duplicate.title: Duplicating Template Facts
duplicate.description: The duplicate function creates a new template fact from the slot values of an existing template fact.

assert-string.name: assert-string
assert-string.title: Asserting a String
assert-string.description: The assert-string function is similar to the assert function in that it creates a new fact and adds it to the fact-list.

fact-index.name: fact-index
fact-index.title: Getting the Fact-Index of a Fact-address
fact-index.description: The fact-index function returns the fact-index (an integer) of a fact-address.

fact-existp.name: fact-existp
fact-existp.title: Determining If a Fact Exists
fact-existp.description: The fact-existp function returns the symbol TRUE if the fact specified by its fact-index or fact- address argument exists; otherwise, the symbol FALSE is returned.

fact-relation.name: fact-relation
fact-relation.title: Determining the Deftemplate (Relation) Name Associated with a Fact
fact-relation.description: The fact-relation function returns the deftemplate (relation) name associated with the fact.

fact-slot-names.name: fact-slot-names
fact-slot-names.title: Determining the Slot Names Associated with a Fact
fact-slot-names.description: The fact-slot-names function returns a multifield value containing the slot names associated with a fact.

fact-slot-value.name: fact-slot-value
fact-slot-value.title: Retrieving the Slot Value of a Fact
fact-slot-value.description: The fact-slot-value function returns the value of the specified slot from the specified fact.

get-fact-list.name: get-fact-list
get-fact-list.title: Retrieving the Fact-List
get-fact-list.description: The get-fact-list function returns a multifield containing the list of facts visible to the module specified by <module-name> or to the current module if none is specified.

any-factp.name: any-factp
any-factp.title: Testing if Any Fact-set Satisfies a Query
any-factp.description: The any-factp function applies a query to each fact-set which matches the template.

find-fact.name: find-fact
find-fact.title: Determining the First Fact-set Satisfying a Query
find-fact.description: The find-fact function applies a query to each fact-set which matches the template.

find-all-facts.name: find-all-facts
find-all-facts.title: Determining All Fact-sets Satisfying a Query
find-all-facts.description: The find-all-facts function applies a query to each fact-set which matches the template.

do-for-fact.name: do-for-fact
do-for-fact.title: Executing an Action for the First Fact-set Satisfying a Query
do-for-fact.description: The do-for-fact function applies a query to each fact-set which matches the template.

do-for-all-facts.name: do-for-all-facts
do-for-all-facts.title: Executing an Action for All Fact-sets Satisfying a Query
do-for-all-facts.description: The do-for-all-facts function applies a query to each fact-set which matches the template.

delayed-do-for-all-facts.name: delayed-do-for-all-facts
delayed-do-for-all-facts.title: Executing a Delayed Action for All Fact-sets Satisfying a Query
delayed-do-for-all-facts.description: The delayed-do-for-all-facts function is similar to the do-for-all-facts function except that it groups all fact-sets which satisfy the query into an intermediary multifield value.

fact-index-to-fact.name: fact-index-to-fact
fact-index-to-fact.title: Getting the Fact-address Associated with a Fact-Index
fact-index-to-fact.description: The fact-index-to-fact function returns the fact-address associated with a fact-index (an integer).

get-deffacts-list.name: get-deffacts-list
get-deffacts-list.title: Getting the List of Deffacts
get-deffacts-list.description: The get-deffacts-list function returns a multifield value containing the names of all deffacts constructs visible to the module specified by <module-name> or to the current module if none is specified.

deffacts-module.name: deffacts-module
deffacts-module.title: Determining the Module in which a Deffacts is Defined
deffacts-module.description: The deffacts-module function returns the module in which the specified deffacts name is defined.

get-defrule-list.name: get-defrule-list
get-defrule-list.title: Getting the List of Defrules
get-defrule-list.description: The get-defrule-list function returns a multifield value containing the names of all defrule constructs visible to the module specified by <module-name> or to the current module if none is specified.

defrule-module.name: defrule-module
defrule-module.title: Determining the Module in which a Defrule is Defined
defrule-module.description: The defrule-module function returns the module in which the specified defrule name is defined.

get-focus.name: get-focus
get-focus.title: Getting the Current Focus
get-focus.description: The get-focus function returns the module name of the current focus.

get-focus-stack.name: get-focus-stack
get-focus-stack.title: Getting the Focus Stack
get-focus-stack.description: The get-focus-stack function returns a multifield value containing all of the module names in the focus stack.

pop-focus.name: pop-focus
pop-focus.title: Removing the Current Focus from the Focus Stack
pop-focus.description: The pop-focus function removes the current focus from the focus stack and returns the module name of the current focus.

get-defglobal-list.name: get-defglobal-list
get-defglobal-list.title: Getting the List of Defglobals
get-defglobal-list.description: The get-defglobal-list function returns a multifield value containing the names of all global variables visible to the module specified by <module-name> or to the current module if none is specified.

defglobal-module.name: defglobal-module
defglobal-module.title: Determining the Module in which a Defglobal is Defined
defglobal-module.description: The defglobal-module function returns the module in which the specified defglobal name is defined.

get-deffunction-list.name: get-deffunction-list
get-deffunction-list.title: Getting the List of Deffunctions
get-deffunction-list.description: The get-deffunction-list function returns a multifield value containing the names of all deffunction constructs visible to the module specified by <module-name> or to the current module if none is specified.

deffunction-module.name: deffunction-module
deffunction-module.title: Determining the Module in which a Deffunction is Defined
deffunction-module.description: The deffunction-module function returns the module in which the specified deffunction name is defined.

get-defgeneric-list.name: get-defgeneric-list
get-defgeneric-list.title: Getting the List of Defgenerics
get-defgeneric-list.description: The get-defgeneric-list function returns a multifield value containing the names of all defgeneric constructs that are currently defined.

defgeneric-module.name: defgeneric-module
defgeneric-module.title: Determining the Module in which a Generic Function is Defined
defgeneric-module.description: The defgeneric-module function returns the module in which the specified defgeneric name is defined.

get-defmethod-list.name: get-defmethod-list
get-defmethod-list.title: Getting the List of Defmethods
get-defmethod-list.description: The get-defmethod-list function returns a multifield value containing method name/indices pairs for all defmethod constructs that are currently defined.

next-methodp.name: next-methodp
next-methodp.title: Existence of Shadowed Methods
next-methodp.description: If called from a method for a generic function, the next-methodp function will return the symbol TRUE if there is another method shadowed by the current one; otherwise, the function will return the symbol FALSE.

call-next-method.name: call-next-method
call-next-method.title: Calling Shadowed Methods
call-next-method.description: If the conditions are such that the next-methodp function would return the symbol TRUE, then calling the call-next-method function will execute the shadowed method; otherwise, a method execution error will occur.

override-next-method.name: override-next-method
override-next-method.title: Calling Shadowed Methods with Overrides
override-next-method.description: The override-next-method function is similar to call-next-method, except that new arguments can be provided.

call-specific-method.name: call-specific-method
call-specific-method.title: Calling a Specific Method
call-specific-method.description: The call-specific-method function allows a particular method of a generic function to be called without regards to method precedence.

get-method-restrictions.name: get-method-restrictions
get-method-restrictions.title: Getting the Restrictions of Defmethods
get-method-restrictions.description: The get-method-restrictions function returns a multifield value containing information about the restrictions for the specified method using the following format: <minimum-number-of-arguments> <maximum-number-of-arguments> (can be -1 for wildcards) <number-of-restrictions> <multifield-index-of-first-restriction-info> .

get-defclass-list.name: get-defclass-list
get-defclass-list.title: Getting the List of Defclasses
get-defclass-list.description: The get-defclass-list function returns a multifield value containing the names of all defclass constructs visible to the module specified by <module-name> or to the current module if none is specified.

defclass-module.name: defclass-module
defclass-module.title: Determining the Module in which a Defclass is Defined
defclass-module.description: The defclass-module function returns the module in which the specified defclass name is defined.

class-existp.name: class-existp
class-existp.title: Determining if a Class Exists
class-existp.description: The class-existp function returns the symbol TRUE if the specified class is defined; otherwise, it returns the symbol FALSE.

superclassp.name: superclassp
superclassp.title: Superclass Determination
superclassp.description: The superclassp function returns the symbol TRUE if the first class is a superclass of the second class; otherwise, it returns the symbol FALSE.

subclassp.name: subclassp
subclassp.title: Subclass Determination
subclassp.description: The subclassp function returns the symbol TRUE if the first class is a subclass of the second class; otherwise, it returns the symbol FALSE.

slot-existp.name: slot-existp
slot-existp.title: Slot Existence
slot-existp.description: The slot-existp function returns the symbol TRUE if the specified slot is present in the specified class; otherwise, it returns the symbol FALSE. If the inherit keyword is specified, then the slot may be inherited; otherwise it must be directly defined in the specified class.

slot-writablep.name: slot-writablep
slot-writablep.title: Testing whether a Slot is Writable
slot-writablep.description: The slot-writablep function returns the symbol TRUE if the specified slot in the specified class is writable; otherwise, it returns the symbol FALSE. An error is generated if the specified class or slot does not exist.

slot-initablep.name: slot-initablep
slot-initablep.title: Testing whether a Slot is Initializable
slot-initablep.description: The slot-initablep function returns the symbol TRUE if the specified slot in the specified class is initializable; otherwise, it returns the symbol FALSE. An error is generated if the specified class or slot does not exist.

slot-publicp.name: slot-publicp
slot-publicp.title: Testing whether a Slot is Public
slot-publicp.description: The slot-publicp function returns the symbol TRUE if the specified slot in the specified class is public; otherwise, it returns the symbol FALSE. An error is generated if the specified class or slot does not exist.

slot-direct-accessp.name: slot-direct-accessp
slot-direct-accessp.title: Testing whether a Slot can be Accessed Directly
slot-direct-accessp.description: The slot-direct-accessp function returns the symbol TRUE if the specified slot in the specified class can be accessed directly; otherwise, it returns the symbol FALSE. An error is generated if the specified class or slot does not exist.

message-handler-existp.name: message-handler-existp
message-handler-existp.title: Message-handler Existence
message-handler-existp.description: The message-handler-existp function returns the symbol TRUE if the specified message-handler is defined (directly only, not by inheritance) for the class; otherwise, it returns the symbol FALSE. If unspecified, the <handler-type> term defaults to the symbol primary.

class-abstractp.name: class-abstractp
class-abstractp.title: Determining if a Class can have Direct Instances
class-abstractp.description: The class-abstractp function returns the symbol TRUE if the specified class is abstract (i.e. the class cannot have direct instances); otherwise, it returns the symbol FALSE.

class-reactivep.name: class-reactivep
class-reactivep.title: Determining if a Class can Satisfy Object Patterns
class-reactivep.description: The class-reactivep function returns the symbol TRUE if the specified class is reactive (i.e. objects of the class can match object patterns); otherwise it returns the symbol FALSE.

class-superclasses.name: class-superclasses
class-superclasses.title: Getting the List of Superclasses for a Class
class-superclasses.description: The class-superclasses function returns a multifield value containing the names of the direct superclasses of the specified class.

class-subclasses.name: class-subclasses
class-subclasses.title: Getting the List of Subclasses for a Class
class-subclasses.description: The class-subclasses function returns a multifield value containing the names of the direct subclasses of the specified class.

class-slots.name: class-slots
class-slots.title: Getting the List of Slots for a Class
class-slots.description: The class-slots function returns a multifield value containing the names of the explicitly defined slots of the specified class.

get-defmessage-handler-list.name: get-defmessage-handler-list
get-defmessage-handler-list.title: Getting the List of Message-Handlers for a Class
get-defmessage-handler-list.description: The get-defmessage-handler-list function returns a multifield value containing the class names, message names, and message types of the message-handlers attached directly to the specified class (implicit slot-accessors are not included).

slot-facets.name: slot-facets
slot-facets.title: Getting the List of Facets for a Slot
slot-facets.description: The slot-facets function returns a multifield value containing the facet values for the specified slot (the slot can be inherited or explicitly defined for the class).

slot-sources.name: slot-sources
slot-sources.title: Getting the List of Source Classes for a Slot
slot-sources.description: The slot-sources function returns a multifield value containing the names of the classes which provide facets for a slot of the specified class.

slot-types.name: slot-types
slot-types.title: Getting the Primitive Types for a Slot
slot-types.description: The slot-types function returns a multifield value containing the names of the primitive types allowed for a slot.

slot-cardinality.name: slot-cardinality
slot-cardinality.title: Getting the Cardinality for a Slot
slot-cardinality.description: The slot-cardinality function returns a multifield value containing the minimum and maximum cardinality allowed for a multifield slot of the specified class.

slot-allowed-values.name: slot-allowed-values
slot-allowed-values.title: Getting the Allowed Values for a Slot
slot-allowed-values.description: The slot-allowed-values function returns a multifield value containing the allowed values for a slot (specified in any of allowed-… facets for the slots).

slot-range.name: slot-range
slot-range.title: Getting the Numeric Range for a Slot
slot-range.description: The slot-range function returns a multifield value containing the minimum and maximum numeric ranges allowed a slot.

slot-default-value.name: slot-default-value
slot-default-value.title: Getting the Default Value for a Slot
slot-default-value.description: The slot-default-value function returns the default value associated with a slot.

set-class-defaults-mode.name: set-class-defaults-mode
set-class-defaults-mode.title: Setting the Defaults Mode for Classes
set-class-defaults-mode.description: The set-class-defaults-mode function sets the defaults mode used when classes are defined.

get-class-defaults-mode.name: get-class-defaults-mode
get-class-defaults-mode.title: Getting the Defaults Mode for Classes
get-class-defaults-mode.description: The get-class-defaults-mode function returns the current defaults mode used when classes are defined (convenience or conservation).

slot-allowed-classes.name: slot-allowed-classes
slot-allowed-classes.title: Getting the Allowed Classes for a Slot
slot-allowed-classes.description: The slot-allowed-classes function returns a multifield value containing the allowed classes for a slot (specified by the allowed-classes facet for the slot).

next-handlerp.name: next-handlerp
next-handlerp.title: Existence of Shadowed Handlers
next-handlerp.description: The next-handlerp function returns the symbol TRUE if there is another message-handler available for execution; otherwise, it returns the symbol FALSE. If this function is called from an around handler and there are any shadowed handlers, the return value is the symbol TRUE. If this function is called from a primary handler and there are any shadowed primary handlers, the return value is the symbol TRUE. In any other circumstance, the return value is the symbol FALSE.

call-next-handler.name: call-next-handler
call-next-handler.title: Calling Shadowed Handlers
call-next-handler.description: If the conditions are such that the next-handlerp function would return the symbol TRUE, then calling the call-next-handler function will execute the shadowed method; otherwise, a message execution error will occur.

override-next-handler.name: override-next-handler
override-next-handler.title: Calling Shadowed Handlers with Different Arguments
override-next-handler.description: The override-next-handler function is identical to call-next-handler except that it can change the arguments passed to the shadowed handler.

get-definstances-list.name: get-definstances-list
get-definstances-list.title: Getting the List of Definstances
get-definstances-list.description: The get-definstances-list function returns a multifield value containing the names of all definstances constructs visible to the module specified by <module-name> or to the current module if none is specified.

definstances-module.name: definstances-module
definstances-module.title: Determining the Module in which a Definstances is Defined
definstances-module.description: The definstances-module function returns the module in which the specified definstances name is defined.

init-slots.name: init-slots
init-slots.title: Initializing an Instance
init-slots.description: The init-slots function implements the init message-handler attached to the class USER. This function evaluates and places slot expressions given by the class definition that were not specified by slot-overrides in the call to make-instance or initialize-instance.

unmake-instance.name: unmake-instance
unmake-instance.title: Deleting an Instance
unmake-instance.description: The unmake-instance function deletes the specified instances by sending them a delete message.

delete-instance.name: delete-instance
delete-instance.title: Deleting the Active Instance from a Handler
delete-instance.description: The delete-instance function operates implicitly on the active instance for a message, and thus can only be called from within the body of a message-handler.

class.name: class
class.title: Determining the Class of an Object
class.description: The class function returns a symbol which is the name of the class of its argument.

instance-name.name: instance-name
instance-name.title: Determining the Name of an Instance
instance-name.description: The instance-name function returns a symbol which is the name of its instance argument.

instance-address.name: instance-address
instance-address.title: Determining the Address of an Instance
instance-address.description: The instance-address function returns the address of its instance argument.

symbol-to-instance-name.name: symbol-to-instance-name
symbol-to-instance-name.title: Converting a Symbol to an Instance-Name
symbol-to-instance-name.description: The symbol-to-instance-name function returns an instance-name which is equivalent to its symbol argument.

instance-name-to-symbol.name: instance-name-to-symbol
instance-name-to-symbol.title: Converting an Instance-Name to a Symbol
instance-name-to-symbol.description: The instance-name-to-symbol function returns a symbol which is equivalent to its instance-name argument.

instancep.name: instancep
instancep.title: Testing for an Instance
instancep.description: The instancep function returns the symbol TRUE if the evaluation of its argument is an instance-address or an instance-name; otherwise, it returns the symbol FALSE.

instance-addressp.name: instance-addressp
instance-addressp.title: Testing for an Instance-Address
instance-addressp.description: The instance-addressp function returns the symbol TRUE if the evaluation of its argument is an instance-address; otherwise, it returns the symbol FALSE.

instance-namep.name: instance-namep
instance-namep.title: Testing for an Instance-Name
instance-namep.description: The instance-namep function returns the symbol TRUE if the evaluation of its argument is an instance-name; otherwise, it returns the symbol FALSE.

instance-existp.name: instance-existp
instance-existp.title: Testing for the Existence an Instance
instance-existp.description: The instance-existp function returns the symbol TRUE if the specified instance exists; otherwise, it returns the symbol FALSE. If the argument is an instance-name, the function determines if an instance of the specified name exists.

dynamic-get.name: dynamic-get
dynamic-get.title: Reading a Slot Value
dynamic-get.description: The dynamic-get function returns the value of the specified slot of the active instance.

dynamic-put.name: dynamic-put
dynamic-put.title: Setting a Slot Value
dynamic-put.description: The dynamic-put function sets the value of the specified slot of the active instance.

slot-replace$.name: slot-replace$
slot-replace$.title: Replacing Fields in a Slot
slot-replace$.description: The slot-replace$ and slot-direct-replace$ functions allow the replacement of a range of fields in a multifield slot value with one or more new values.

slot-direct-replace$.name: slot-direct-replace$
slot-direct-replace$.title: Replacing Fields in a Slot
slot-direct-replace$.description: The slot-replace$ and slot-direct-replace$ functions allow the replacement of a range of fields in a multifield slot value with one or more new values.

slot-insert$.name: slot-insert$
slot-insert$.title: Inserting Fields in a Slot
slot-insert$.description: The slot-insert$ and slot-direct-insert$ functions allow the insertion of one or more new values in a multifield slot value before a specified field index.

slot-direct-insert$.name: slot-direct-insert$
slot-direct-insert$.title: Inserting Fields in a Slot
slot-direct-insert$.description: The slot-insert$ and slot-direct-insert$ functions allow the insertion of one or more new values in a multifield slot value before a specified field index.

slot-delete$.name: slot-delete$
slot-delete$.title: Deleting Fields in a Slot
slot-delete$.description: The slot-delete$ and slot-direct-delete$ functions allow the deletion of a range of fields in a multifield slot value.

slot-direct-delete$.name: slot-direct-delete$
slot-direct-delete$.title: Deleting Fields in a Slot
slot-direct-delete$.description: The slot-delete$ and slot-direct-delete$ functions allow the deletion of a range of fields in a multifield slot value.

get-defmodule-list.name: get-defmodule-list
get-defmodule-list.title: Getting the List of Defmodules
get-defmodule-list.description: The get-defmodule-list function returns a multifield value containing the names of all defmodules that are currently defined.

set-current-module.name: set-current-module
set-current-module.title: Setting the Current Module
set-current-module.description: The set-current-module function sets the current module.

get-current-module.name: get-current-module
get-current-module.title: Getting the Current Module
get-current-module.description: The get-current-module function returns the name of the current module.

expand$.name: expand$
expand$.title: Multifield Expansion Function
expand$.description: The $ operator is merely a shorthand notation for the expand$ function call.

set-sequence-operator-recognition.name: set-sequence-operator-recognition
set-sequence-operator-recognition.title: Setting The Sequence Operator Recognition Behavior
set-sequence-operator-recognition.description: The set-sequence-operator-recognition function sets the sequence operator recognition behavior.

get-sequence-operator-recognition.name: get-sequence-operator-recognition
get-sequence-operator-recognition.title: Getting The Sequence Operator Recognition Behavior
get-sequence-operator-recognition.description: The get-sequence-operator-recognition function returns the current value of the sequence operator recognition behavior (either the symbol TRUE or FALSE).

load.name: load
load.title: Loading Constructs From A File
load.description: The load command compiles the construct definitions stored in the file specified by the <file-name> argument.

load*.name: load*
load*.title: Loading Constructs From A File without Progress Information
load*.description: The load* command compiles the construct definitions stored in the file specified by the <file-name> argument; however, unlike the load command, informational messsages are not printed to show the progress of compiling the file.

save.name: save
save.title: Saving All Constructs To A File
save.description: The save command writes all construct definitions to the file specified by the <file-name> argument, overwriting the file if it already exists.

bload.name: bload
bload.title: Loading a Binary Image
bload.description: The bload command loads the precompiled constructs stored in the binary file specified by the <file-name> argument.

bsave.name: bsave
bsave.title: Saving a Binary Image
bsave.description: The bsave command writes all of the construct definitions currently loaded to the file specified by the <file-name> argument.

clear.name: clear
clear.title: Clearing CLIPS
clear.description: The clear command removes all constructs and associated data (such as facts and instances).

exit.name: exit
exit.title: Exiting CLIPS
exit.description: The exit command terminates CLIPS execution.

reset.name: reset
reset.title: Resetting CLIPS
reset.description: The reset command removes all activations from the agenda, retracts all facts, deletes all instances, assigns global variables their initial values, asserts all facts from deffacts constructs, creates all instances from definstances constructs, and sets the current module and focus to the MAIN module.

batch.name: batch
batch.title: Executing Commands From a File
batch.description: The batch command allows automatic processing of CLIPS interactive commands by replacing standard input with the contents of a file.

batch*.name: batch*
batch*.title: Executing Commands From a File Without Replacing Standard Input
batch*.description: The batch* command evaluates the series of commands stored in the file specified by the <file-name> argument.

options.name: options
options.title: Determining CLIPS Compilation Options
options.description: The options command prints the compiler flag settings (for enabling/disabling various features) used for creating the CLIPS executable.

system.name: system
system.title: Calling the Operating System
system.description: The system command allows a call to the operating system.

set-dynamic-constraint-checking.name: set-dynamic-constraint-checking
set-dynamic-constraint-checking.title: Setting the Dynamic Constraint Checking Behavior
set-dynamic-constraint-checking.description: The set-dynamic-constraint-checking function sets the dynamic constraint checking behavior.

get-dynamic-constraint-checking.name: get-dynamic-constraint-checking
get-dynamic-constraint-checking.title: Getting the Dynamic Constraint Checking Behavior
get-dynamic-constraint-checking.description: Thze get-dynamic-constraint-checking function returns the current value of the dynamic constraint checking behavior (the symbol TRUE or FALSE).

apropos.name: apropos
apropos.title: Finding Symbols
apropos.description: The apropos command displays all symbols currently defined in CLIPS which contain a specified substring.

dribble-on.name: dribble-on
dribble-on.title: Generating Trace Files
dribble-on.description: The dribble-on command sends all output normally sent to the logical names stdout, werror, and wwarning to the file specified by the <file-name> argument as well as sending output to its normal destination.

dribble-off.name: dribble-off
dribble-off.title: Closing Trace Files
dribble-off.description: The dribble-off command stops sending output to the dribble file and closes it.

watch.name: watch
watch.title: Enabling Watch Items
watch.description: The watch command function enables debugging/informational output for various CLIPS operations.

unwatch.name: unwatch
unwatch.title: Disabling Watch Items
unwatch.description: The unwatch command disables the effect of the watch command for the specified watch item.

list-watch-items.name: list-watch-items
list-watch-items.title: Viewing the Current State of Watch Items
list-watch-items.description: The list-watch-items command displays the current state of watch items.

ppdeftemplate.name: ppdeftemplate
ppdeftemplate.title: Displaying the Text of a Deftemplate
ppdeftemplate.description: The ppdeftemplate command sends the source text of a deftemplate to a logical name as output.

list-deftemplates.name: list-deftemplates
list-deftemplates.title: Displaying the List of Deftemplates
list-deftemplates.description: The list-deftemplates command displays the names of all deftemplates.

undeftemplate.name: undeftemplate
undeftemplate.title: Deleting a Deftemplate
undeftemplate.description: The undeftemplate command deletes a previously defined deftemplate.

facts.name: facts
facts.title: Displaying the Fact-List
facts.description: The facts command lists existing facts.

ppfact.name: ppfact
ppfact.title: Displaying a Single Fact
ppfact.description: The ppfact command displays a single fact, placing each slot and its value on a separate line.

save-facts.name: save-facts
save-facts.title: Saving Facts To A Text File
save-facts.description: The save-facts command saves all of the facts in the current fact-list into the file specified by the <file-name> argument.

bsave-facts.name: bsave-facts
bsave-facts.title: Saving Facts to a Binary File
bsave-facts.description: The bsave-facts commands works exactly like save-facts command except that the facts are saved in a binary format which can only be loaded with the bload-facts command.

load-facts.name: load-facts
load-facts.title: Loading Facts From a Text File
load-facts.description: The load-facts command will read facts in text format from the file specified by the <file-name> argument and assert them.

bload-facts.name: bload-facts
bload-facts.title: Loading Facts from a Binary File
bload-facts.description: The bload-facts command works exactly like load-facts except that it can only work with files generated by bsave-facts.

set-fact-duplication.name: set-fact-duplication
set-fact-duplication.title: Setting the Duplication Behavior of Facts
set-fact-duplication.description: The set-fact-duplication command sets fact duplication behavior.

get-fact-duplication.name: get-fact-duplication
get-fact-duplication.title: Getting the Duplication Behavior of Facts
get-fact-duplication.description: The get-fact-duplication command returns the current value of the fact duplication behavior (the symbol TRUE or FALSE).

ppdeffacts.name: ppdeffacts
ppdeffacts.title: Displaying the Text of a Deffacts
ppdeffacts.description: The ppdeffacts command sends the source text of a deffacts to a logical name as output.

list-deffacts.name: list-deffacts
list-deffacts.title: Displaying the List of Deffacts
list-deffacts.description: The list-deffacts command displays the names of all defined deffacts.

undeffacts.name: undeffacts
undeffacts.title: Deleting a Deffacts
undeffacts.description: The undeffacts command deletes a previously defined deffacts.

ppdefrule.name: ppdefrule
ppdefrule.title: Displaying the Text of a Rule
ppdefrule.description: The ppdefrule command sends the source text of a defrule to a logical name as output.

list-defrules.name: list-defrules
list-defrules.title: Displaying the List of Rules
list-defrules.description: The list-defrules command displays the names of all defined defrules.

undefrule.name: undefrule
undefrule.title: Deleting a Defrule
undefrule.description: The undefrule command deletes a previously defined defrule.

matches.name: matches
matches.title: Displaying Matches for a Rule
matches.description: For the specified defrule, the matches command displays the list of the facts or instances which match each pattern in the rule’s LHS, the partial matches for the rule, and the activations for the rule.

set-break.name: set-break
set-break.title: Setting a Breakpoint for a Rule
set-break.description: The set-break command sets a breakpoint for the specified defrule.

remove-break.name: remove-break
remove-break.title: Removing a Breakpoint for a Rule
remove-break.description: The remove-break command removes a breakpoint for the specified defrule.

show-breaks.name: show-breaks
show-breaks.title: Displaying Rule Breakpoints
show-breaks.description: The show-breaks command displays all the rules which have breakpoints set.

refresh.name: refresh
refresh.title: Refreshing a Rule
refresh.description: The refresh command places all current activations of the specified defrule on the agenda.

dependencies.name: dependencies
dependencies.title: Determining the Logical Dependencies of a Pattern Entity
dependencies.description: The dependencies command lists the partial matches from which a fact or instance receives logical support.

dependents.name: dependents
dependents.title: Determining the Logical Dependents of a Pattern Entity
dependents.description: The dependents command lists all facts and instances which receive logical support from a fact or instance.

agenda.name: agenda
agenda.title: Displaying the Agenda
agenda.description: The agenda command displays all activations on the agenda.

run.name: run
run.title: Running CLIPS
run.description: The run command starts execution of activated rules.

focus.name: focus
focus.title: Focusing on a Group of Rules
focus.description: The focus command pushes one or more modules onto the focus stack.

halt.name: halt
halt.title: Stopping Rule Execution
halt.description: The halt command stops execution of activated rules.

set-strategy.name: set-strategy
set-strategy.title: Setting The Current Conflict Resolution Strategy
set-strategy.description: This set-strategy command sets the current conflict resolution strategy.

get-strategy.name: get-strategy
get-strategy.title: Getting The Current Conflict Resolution Strategy
get-strategy.description: The get-strategy command returns the current conflict resolution strategy (either the symbol depth, breadth, simplicity, complexity, lex, mea, or random).

list-focus-stack.name: list-focus-stack
list-focus-stack.title: Listing the Module Names on the Focus Stack
list-focus-stack.description: The list-focus-stack command lists all module names on the focus stack.

clear-focus-stack.name: clear-focus-stack
clear-focus-stack.title: Removing all Module Names from the Focus Stack
clear-focus-stack.description: The clear-focus-stack command removes all module names from the focus stack.

set-salience-evaluation.name: set-salience-evaluation
set-salience-evaluation.title: Setting the Salience Evaluation Behavior
set-salience-evaluation.description: The set-salience-evaluation command sets the salience evaluation behavior.

get-salience-evaluation.name: get-salience-evaluation
get-salience-evaluation.title: Getting the Salience Evaluation Behavior
get-salience-evaluation.description: The get-salience-evaluation command returns the current salience evaluation behavior (either the symbol when-defined, when-activated, or every-cycle).

refresh-agenda.name: refresh-agenda
refresh-agenda.title: Refreshing the Salience Value of Rules on the Agenda
refresh-agenda.description: The refresh-agenda command reevaluates the saliences of all rules on the agenda regardless of the current salience evaluation setting.

ppdefglobal.name: ppdefglobal
ppdefglobal.title: Displaying the Text of a Defglobal
ppdefglobal.description: The ppdefglobal command sends the source text of a defglobal to a logical name as output.

list-defglobals.name: list-defglobals
list-defglobals.title: Displaying the List of Defglobals
list-defglobals.description: The list-defglobals command displays the names of all defined defglobals.

undefglobal.name: undefglobal
undefglobal.title: Deleting a Defglobal
undefglobal.description: The undefglobal command deletes a previously defined defglobal.

show-defglobals.name: show-defglobals
show-defglobals.title: Displaying the Values of Global Variables
show-defglobals.description: The show-defglobals command displays the name and current value of all defglobals.

set-reset-globals.name: set-reset-globals
set-reset-globals.title: Setting the Reset Behavior of Global Variables
set-reset-globals.description: The set-reset-globals command sets the values of the reset globals behavior.

get-reset-globals.name: get-reset-globals
get-reset-globals.title: Getting the Reset Behavior of Global Variables
get-reset-globals.description: The get-reset-globals command returns the current value of the reset global variables behavior (either the symbol TRUE or FALSE).

ppdeffunction.name: ppdeffunction
ppdeffunction.title: Displaying the Text of a Deffunction
ppdeffunction.description: The ppdeffunction command sends the source text of a deffunction to a logical name as output.

list-deffunctions.name: list-deffunctions
list-deffunctions.title: Displaying the List of Deffunctions
list-deffunctions.description: The list-deffunctions command displays the names of all defined deffunctions.

undeffunction.name: undeffunction
undeffunction.title: Deleting a Deffunction
undeffunction.description: The undeffunction command deletes a previously defined deffunction.

ppdefgeneric.name: ppdefgeneric
ppdefgeneric.title: Displaying the Text of a Generic Function Header
ppdefgeneric.description: The ppdefgeneric command sends the source text of a defgeneric to a logical name as output.

ppdefmethod.name: ppdefmethod
ppdefmethod.title: Displaying the Text of a Generic Function Method
ppdefmethod.description: The ppdefmethod command sends the source text of a defmethod to a logical name as output.

list-defgenerics.name: list-defgenerics
list-defgenerics.title: Displaying the List of Generic Functions
list-defgenerics.description: The list-defgenerics command displays the names of all defined generic functions.

list-defmethods.name: list-defmethods
list-defmethods.title: Displaying the List of Methods for a Generic Function
list-defmethods.description: The list-defmethods command displays the names, arguments, and indices of all defined defmethods.

undefgeneric.name: undefgeneric
undefgeneric.title: Deleting a Generic Function
undefgeneric.description: The undefgeneric command deletes a previously defined generic function.

undefmethod.name: undefmethod
undefmethod.title: Deleting a Generic Function Method
undefmethod.description: The undefmethod command deletes a previously defined generic function method.

preview-generic.name: preview-generic
preview-generic.title: Previewing a Generic Function Call
preview-generic.description: The preview-generic command lists all applicable methods for a particular generic function call in order of decreasing precedence.

ppdefclass.name: ppdefclass
ppdefclass.title: Displaying the Text of a Defclass
ppdefclass.description: The ppdefclass command sends the source text of a defclass to a logical name as output.

list-defclasses.name: list-defclasses
list-defclasses.title: Displaying the List of Defclasses
list-defclasses.description: The list-defclasses command displays the names of all defined defclasses.

undefclass.name: undefclass
undefclass.title: Deleting a Defclass
undefclass.description: The undefclass command deletes a previously defined defclass and all its subclasses.

describe-class.name: describe-class
describe-class.title: Examining a Class
describe-class.description: The describe-class command provides a verbose description of a class including its role (whether direct instances can be created or not), direct superclasses and subclasses, class precedence list, slots with all their facets and sources, and all recognized message-handlers.

browse-classes.name: browse-classes
browse-classes.title: Examining the Class Hierarchy
browse-classes.description: The browse-classes command provides a rudimentary display of the inheritance relationships between a class and all its subclasses.

ppdefmessage-handler.name: ppdefmessage-handler
ppdefmessage-handler.title: Displaying the Text of a Defmessage-handler
ppdefmessage-handler.description: The ppdefmessage-handler command sends the source text of a defmessage-handler to a logical name as output.

list-defmessage-handlers.name: list-defmessage-handlers
list-defmessage-handlers.title: Displaying the List of Defmessage-handlers
list-defmessage-handlers.description: The list-defmessage-handlers command displays the names of defined defmessage-handlers.

undefmessage-handler.name: undefmessage-handler
undefmessage-handler.title: Deleting a Defmessage-handler
undefmessage-handler.description: The undefmessage-handler command deletes a previously defined message-handler.

preview-send.name: preview-send
preview-send.title: Previewing a Message
preview-send.description: The preview-send command displays a list of all the applicable message-handlers for a message sent to an instance of a particular class.

ppdefinstances.name: ppdefinstances
ppdefinstances.title: Displaying the Text of a Definstances
ppdefinstances.description: The ppdefinstances command sends the source text of a definstances to a logical name as output.

list-definstances.name: list-definstances
list-definstances.title: Displaying the List of Definstances
list-definstances.description: The list-definstances command displays the names of all defined definstances.

undefinstances.name: undefinstances
undefinstances.title: Deleting a Definstances
undefinstances.description: The undefinstances command deletes a previously defined definstances.

instances.name: instances
instances.title: Listing the Instances
instances.description: The instances command lists existing instances.

ppinstance.name: ppinstance
ppinstance.title: Printing an Instance’s Slots from a Handler
ppinstance.description: The ppinstance command directly prints the slots of the active instance and is the one used to implement the print handler attached to class USER. This command operates implicitly on the active instance for a message, and thus can only be called from within the body of a message-handler.

save-instances.name: save-instances
save-instances.title: Saving Instances to a Text File
save-instances.description: The save-instances command saves all instances to the specified file using the following format.

bsave-instances.name: bsave-instances
bsave-instances.title: Saving Instances to a Binary File
bsave-instances.description: The bsave-instances command works exactly like save-instances command except that the instances are saved in a binary format which can only be loaded with the bload-instances command.

load-instances.name: load-instances
load-instances.title: Loading Instances from a Text File
load-instances.description: The load-instances command loads instances in text format from a file and creates them.

restore-instances.name: restore-instances
restore-instances.title: Loading Instances from a Text File without Message Passing
restore-instances.description: The restore-instances command loads instances from a file into the CLIPS environment.

bload-instances.name: bload-instances
bload-instances.title: Loading Instances from a Binary File
bload-instances.description: The bload-instances command is similar to restore-instances except that it can only work with files generated by bsave-instances.

ppdefmodule.name: ppdefmodule
ppdefmodule.title: Displaying the Text of a Defmodule
ppdefmodule.description: The ppdefmodule command sends the source text of a defmodule to a logical name as output.

list-defmodules.name: list-defmodules
list-defmodules.title: Displaying the List of Defmodules
list-defmodules.description: The list-defmodules command displays the names of all defined defmodule constructs.

mem-used.name: mem-used
mem-used.title: Determining the Amount of Memory Used by CLIPS
mem-used.description: The mem-used command returns an integer representing the number of bytes CLIPS has currently in-use or cached for later use.

mem-requests.name: mem-requests
mem-requests.title: Determining the Number of Memory Requests Made by CLIPS
mem-requests.description: The mem-requests command returns an integer representing the number of outstanding memory requests CLIPS has made from the operating system.

release-mem.name: release-mem
release-mem.title: Releasing Memory Used by CLIPS
release-mem.description: The release-mem command releases all free memory cached by CLIPS back to the operating system.

conserve-mem.name: conserve-mem
conserve-mem.title: Conserving Memory
conserve-mem.description: The conserve-mem command is used to enable or disable the storage of the text representation for constructs used by the save and pp<construct> commands.

fetch.name: fetch
fetch.title: Loading External Text
fetch.description: The fetch command loads the named file into the internal lookup table.

print-region.name: print-region
print-region.title: Printing External Text
print-region.description: The print-region command looks up a specified entry in a particular file which has been loaded previously into the lookup table and prints the contents of that entry to the specified output.

get-region.name: get-region
get-region.title: Retrieving External Text
get-region.description: The get-region command looks up a specified entry in a particular file which has been loaded previously into the lookup table and returns the contents of that entry as a string.

toss.name: toss
toss.title: Unloading an External Text File
toss.description: The toss command unloads the named file from the internal lookup table and releases the memory back to the system.

set-profile-percent-threshold.name: set-profile-percent-threshold
set-profile-percent-threshold.title: Setting the Profiling Report Threshold
set-profile-percent-threshold.description: The set-profile-percent-threshold command sets the minimum percentage of time that must be spent executing a construct or user function for it to be displayed by the profile-info command.

get-profile-percent-threshold.name: get-profile-percent-threshold
get-profile-percent-threshold.title: Getting the Profiling Report Threshold
get-profile-percent-threshold.description: The get-profile-percent-threshold command returns the current value of the profile percent threshold.

profile-reset.name: profile-reset
profile-reset.title: Resetting Profiling Information
profile-reset.description: The profile-reset command resets all profiling information currently collected for constructs and user functions.

profile-info.name: profile-info
profile-info.title: Displaying Profiling Information
profile-info.description: The profile-info command displays profiling information currently collected for constructs or user functions.

profile.name: profile
profile.title: Profiling Constructs and User Functions
profile.description: The profile command is used to enable/disable profiling of constructs and user functions.
